light.name: Light
light.text: A cold light on the blade. It lasts 12 turns.

say: Cold light gathers on the blade.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.text: Puts weak foes to sleep. Rolls 2d8 hit dice.

turn-undead.name: Turn Undead
turn-undead.text: A rite against the bound dead. Used at a choice.

speak-animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak-animals.text: Ask the beasts. Used at a choice.

read-about-this.name: I've Read About This
read-about-this.text: Once a delve. You have read about this. A choice may give a fact.

land-speaks.name: The Land Speaks
land-speaks.text: Once a delve. The land gives a fact.

remember-when.name: I Remember When
remember-when.text: Once a delve. You remember a fact from long ago.

know-how-made.name: I Know How This Was Made
know-how-made.text: Once a delve. You know how a thing was made.

oath-remembers.name: The Oath Remembers
oath-remembers.text: Once a delve. Your oath gives a fact.

archives-deep.name: The Archives Are Deep
archives-deep.text: Once a delve. The archives give a fact.

terminal-remembers.name: The Terminal Remembers
terminal-remembers.text: Once a delve. The terminal gives a fact.
